1: # commieD
2: 
3: A collaborative communist-themed maze shooter. Two collectives share one HP
4: pool, one ammo reserve, and one dash reserve. Players who fall become ghosts and
5: work the minigames that keep their living comrades supplied.
6: 
7: ## Play
8: 
9: ```sh
10: node server/server.js
11: ```
12: 
13: Open `http://localhost:8080/main-game/`. Pick a name and a collective, then join.
14: The server owns the match, the bots, and one shared factory per team.
15: 
16: Local practice without the server:
17: 
18: ```sh
19: python3 -m http.server 8000
20: ```
21: 
22: Open `http://localhost:8000/main-game/?local=1`.
23: 
24: ## How the pieces connect
25: 
26: - **Main game** (`main-game/`) renders the maze and sends inputs to the server.
27:   In local mode it runs the same deterministic `Game` in the browser.
28: - **Soul Clicker** (`soul-clicker/`) pays the team HP over time based on CPS.
29:   Low CPS is a signed negative contribution routed through `Game#drainHp`.
30: - **Bullet Press** (`bullet-press/`) turns clean magazines into `10 × multiplier`
31:   rounds of shared team ammo.
32: - **Dash Supplement Factory** (`dash-supplement-factory/`) is one shared floor
33:   per team. Every ghost sees the same pots, claims, cursors, and bottling line;
34:   each bottled pot awards 20 seconds of team dash.
35: - **Server** (`server/`) is dependency-free Node. It serves the static pages,
36:   speaks raw WebSocket, runs the authoritative room, replaces bots with humans,
37:   and resets the match.
38: 
39: The host embeds one minigame at a time in the ghost console so background tabs
40: never generate resources. Minigames only talk to the host; the host is the only
41: thing that talks to the server.
42: 
43: ## Test
44: 
45: ```sh
46: (cd main-game && npm test)
47: (cd soul-clicker && npm test)
48: (cd dash-supplement-factory && npm test)
49: (cd server && npm test)
50: ```
51: 
52: Bullet Press still has three failing multiplier tests that predate the
53: integration; its rendering and key handling are unchanged.
54: 
55: ## Layout
56: 
57: | Path | Purpose |
58: | --- | --- |
59: | `main-game/` | Maze client, HUD, lobby, ghost console, local fallback |
60: | `server/` | HTTP static host, WebSocket codec, authoritative room |
61: | `soul-clicker/` | HP ghost minigame |
62: | `bullet-press/` | Ammo ghost minigame |
63: | `dash-supplement-factory/` | Shared dash ghost minigame |
64: | `shared/theme.css` | One palette for all pages |
65: | `assets-needed.md` | Every image, video, audio, and font asset still needed |
66: | `checklist.md` | Verified work |
67: | `minigames.md` | Working specs and open questions |
68: 
69: `idea.md` is the product source of truth and is never edited. Stewed Luck is
70: still unimplemented.

60: function sendJson(response, status, value) {
61:   const body = JSON.stringify(value);
62:   response.writeHead(status, {
63:     'Content-Type': MIME['.json'],
64:     'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body),
65:     'Cache-Control': 'no-store',

67:   response.end(body);

70: async function serveStatic(request, response) {
71:   if (request.method !== 'GET' && request.method !== 'HEAD') {
72:     response.writeHead(405, { Allow: 'GET, HEAD' });
73:     response.end('Method Not Allowed');
74:     return;
75:   }
76: 
77:   const url = new URL(request.url, 'http://localhost');
78: 
79:   if (url.pathname === '/') {
80:     response.writeHead(302, { Location: '/main-game/' });
81:     response.end();
82:     return;
83:   }
84: 
85:   if (url.pathname === '/health') {
86:     sendJson(response, 200, { ok: true });
87:     return;
88:   }
89: 
90:   const filePath = safePath(url.pathname);
91:   if (!filePath) {
92:     response.writeHead(400);
93:     response.end('Bad Request');
94:     return;
95:   }
96: 
97:   let info;
98: 
99:   try {
100:     info = await stat(filePath);
101:   } catch {
102:     response.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
103:     response.end('Not Found');
104:     return;
105:   }
106: 
107:   if (info.isDirectory()) {
108:     response.writeHead(302, { Location: `${url.pathname.replace(/\/?$/, '/')}index.html` });
109:     response.end();
110:     return;
111:   }
112: 
113:   const type = MIME[path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase()] ?? 'application/octet-stream';
114:   response.writeHead(200, {
115:     'Content-Type': type,
116:     'Content-Length': info.size,
117:     'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
118:     'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
119:   });
120: 
121:   if (request.method === 'HEAD') {
122:     response.end();
123:     return;
124:   }
125: 
126:   createReadStream(filePath)
127:     .on('error', () => {
128:       if (!response.headersSent) {
129:         response.writeHead(500);
130:       }
131:       response.end();
132:     })
133:     .pipe(response);
134: }

137:  * Build the HTTP + WebSocket server without listening. Useful in tests.

139: export function createGameServer({ seed, room: providedRoom, tickMs = 33, snapshotMs = 50 } = {}) {
140:   const room = providedRoom ?? new Room(seed === undefined ? {} : { seed });
141:   const httpServer = createServer((request, response) => {
142:     serveStatic(request, response).catch(() => {
143:       if (!response.headersSent) {
144:         response.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
145:       }
146:       response.end('Internal Server Error');
147:     });
148:   });
149: 
150:   const connections = new Map();
151: 
152:   attachWebSocketServer(httpServer, {
153:     path: '/ws',
154:     onConnection(connection) {
155:       const client = room.addClient({
156:         send(message) {
157:           connection.sendJson(message);
158:         },
159:       });
160:       connections.set(client.id, connection);
161: 
162:       connection.setMessageHandler((raw) => {
163:         let message;
164: 
165:         try {
166:           message = JSON.parse(String(raw));
167:         } catch {
168:           return;
169:         }
170: 
171:         if (!message || typeof message.type !== 'string') {
172:           return;
173:         }
174: 
175:         switch (message.type) {
176:           case 'join': {
177:             const result = room.join(client.id, {
178:               name: message.name,
179:               teamId: message.teamId,
180:             });
181:             if (!result.accepted) {
182:               client.send({ type: 'join-rejected', reason: result.reason });
183:             }
184:             break;
185:           }
186:           case 'input':
187:             room.handleInput(client.id, message);
188:             break;
189:           case 'contribute': {
190:             const result = room.handleContribution(client.id, message);
191:             if (!result.accepted) {
192:               client.send({ type: 'contribution-rejected', reason: result.reason });
193:             }
194:             break;
195:           }
196:           case 'factory': {
197:             const result = room.handleFactoryAction(client.id, message);
198:             if (result?.type === 'rejected') {
199:               client.send({ type: 'factory-reject', ...result });
200:             }
201:             break;
202:           }
203:           case 'pointer':
204:             room.handlePointer(client.id, message);
205:             break;
206:           case 'rematch':
207:             room.requestRematch(client.id);
208:             break;
209:           case 'ping':
210:             client.send({ type: 'pong', time: Date.now() });
211:             break;
212:           default:
213:             break;
214:         }
215:       });
216: 
217:       connection.onClose = () => {
218:         connections.delete(client.id);
219:         room.removeClient(client.id);
220:       };
221: 
222:       client.send({
223:         type: 'hello',
224:         clientId: client.id,
225:         teams: room.game.teams.map((team) => ({
226:           id: team.id,
227:           name: team.name,
228:           color: team.color,
229:         })),
230:         playersPerTeam: room.options.playersPerTeam,
231:         generation: room.generation,
232:       });
233:     },
234:   });
235: 
236:   let lastTick = performance.now();
237:   let lastSnapshot = lastTick;
238: 
239:   const tickTimer = setInterval(() => {
240:     const now = performance.now();
241:     const delta = Math.min(100, now - lastTick);
242:     lastTick = now;
243:     room.step(delta);
244: 
245:     if (now - lastSnapshot >= snapshotMs) {
246:       lastSnapshot = now;
247:       room.broadcastSnapshot();
248:     }
249:   }, tickMs);
250:   tickTimer.unref?.();
251: 
252:   const pingTimer = setInterval(() => {
253:     for (const connection of connections.values()) {
254:       connection.ping();
255:     }
256:   }, 25_000);
257:   pingTimer.unref?.();
258: 
259:   httpServer.on('close', () => {
260:     clearInterval(tickTimer);
261:     clearInterval(pingTimer);
262:   });
263: 
264:   return { httpServer, room };
265: }
266: 
267: export function startServer({ port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 8080, host = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0' } = {}) {
268:   const { httpServer, room } = createGameServer();
269: 
270:   httpServer.listen(port, host, () => {
271:     console.log(`commieD server listening on http://${host}:${port}`);
272:     console.log(`Open http://localhost:${port}/main-game/`);
273:     console.log(`Match seed ${room.game.seed}; ${room.options.teams} teams x ${room.options.playersPerTeam}.`);
274:   });
275: 
276:   const shutdown = () => {
277:     httpServer.close(() => process.exit(0));
278:     setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 2000).unref();
279:   };
280: 
281:   process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
282:   process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);
283: 
284:   return { httpServer, room };
285: }

106:     }

113:   show() {

133:     if (notify) {

138:   /* ------------------------------ internals ------------------------------ */
139: 
140:   #ensureFrame() {
141:     if (this.loadedTask === this.task) {
142:       return;
143:     }
144: 
145:     const meta = MINIGAMES[this.task];
146:     this.loadedTask = this.task;
147:     this.frameLoaded = false;
148:     this.frame.src = `${meta.src}?embed=1`;
149:   }
150: 
151:   #renderChrome() {
152:     const meta = MINIGAMES[this.task];
153:     this.root.dataset.task = this.task;
154:     this.title.textContent = meta.title;
155:     this.hint.textContent = meta.hint;
156: 
157:     for (const tab of this.tabs) {
158:       tab.classList.toggle('is-active', tab.dataset.ghostTask === this.task);
159:       tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(tab.dataset.ghostTask === this.task));
160:     }
161: 
162:     if (this.state?.eliminated) {
163:       this.status.textContent = 'TEAM ELIMINATED — PRODUCTION HALTED';
164:     } else if (this.task === 'dash' && this.state?.factory) {
165:       const factory = this.state.factory;
166:       this.status.textContent = `${factory.vialsProduced} VIALS · ${factory.secondsProduced}s DASH BANKED · ${factory.potsSpoiled} SPOILED`;
167:     } else if (this.task === 'clicker') {
168:       this.status.textContent = `TEAM HP ${Number(this.state?.hp ?? 0).toFixed(1)} · ${this.state?.livingTeammates ?? 0} LIVING`;
169:     } else {
170:       this.status.textContent = `TEAM AMMO ${Math.floor(this.state?.ammo ?? 0)} · SHARED BY ALL COMRADES`;
171:     }
172:   }
173: 
174:   #sendState() {
175:     if (!this.frameLoaded || !this.frame?.contentWindow) {
176:       return;
177:     }
178: 
179:     this.frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
180:       {
181:         type: 'state',
182:         game: this.task,
183:         clientId: this.identity.clientId,
184:         teamId: this.identity.teamId,
185:         playerId: this.identity.playerId,

190:         ammo: this.state?.ammo ?? 0,
191:         factory: this.task === 'dash' ? this.state?.factory ?? null : null,
192:         eliminated: Boolean(this.state?.eliminated),
193:       },
194:       window.location.origin,
195:     );
196:   }
197: 
198:   #handleMessage(data) {
199:     if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
200:       return;
201:     }
202: 
203:     if (data.type === 'minigame-ready') {
204:       this.#sendState();
205:       this.frame.contentWindow?.focus();
206:       return;
207:     }
208: 
209:     if (data.type === 'contribute') {
210:       this.onContribute({
211:         game: data.game,
212:         resources: data.resources ?? {},
213:       });
214:       return;
215:     }
216: 
217:     if (data.type === 'factory-action') {
218:       this.onFactoryAction({
219:         action: data.action,
220:         potId: data.potId,
221:         targetId: data.targetId,
222:       });
223:       return;
224:     }
225: 
226:     if (data.type === 'pointer') {
227:       const now = performance.now();
228:       if (data.active !== false && now < this.pointerNext) {
229:         return;
230:       }
231:       this.pointerNext = now + 60;
232:       this.onPointer({ x: data.x, y: data.y, active: data.active });
233:     }
234:   }
235: }

237: export { MINIGAMES, TASKS };

397: function flyBullet(correct, startRect, endRect) {

408:   const dy = endRect.top + endRect.height / 2 - (startRect.top + startRect.height / 2);
409:   const scaleX = endRect.width / startRect.width;
410:   const scaleY = endRect.height / startRect.height;
411: 
412:   const animation = rect.animate(
413:     [
414:       { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)', opacity: 1 },
415:       { transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px) scale(${scaleX}, ${scaleY})`, opacity: 1 },

420:   animation.finished.then(() => rect.remove()).catch(() => rect.remove());

    }
  };

  carveCell(0, 0);

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const [col, row] = stack[stack.length - 1];
    const options = [];

    for (const [dc, dr] of [
      [0, -1],
      [0, 1],
      [-1, 0],
      [1, 0],
    ]) {
      const nextCol = col + dc;
      const nextRow = row + dr;

      if (nextCol < 0 || nextRow < 0 || nextCol >= cols || nextRow >= rows) {
        continue;
      }
      if (visited.has(keyOf(nextCol, nextRow))) {
        continue;
      }
      options.push([nextCol, nextRow, dc, dr]);
    }

    if (options.length === 0) {
      stack.pop();
      continue;
    }

    const [nextCol, nextRow, dc, dr] = options[rng.int(options.length)];

    // Remove the one-tile wall between the two 2x2 cells. Because the wall is
    // carved for both rows (or both columns), the opening stays two tiles wide.
    if (dc === 1) {
      for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
        tiles[(cellY(row) + y) * width + cellX(col) + CELL_SIZE] = TILE.FREE;
      }
    } else if (dc === -1) {
      for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
        tiles[(cellY(row) + y) * width + cellX(col) - 1] = TILE.FREE;
      }
    } else if (dr === 1) {
      for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
        tiles[(cellY(row) + CELL_SIZE) * width + cellX(col) + x] = TILE.FREE;
      }
    } else if (dr === -1) {
      for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
        tiles[(cellY(row) - 1) * width + cellX(col) + x] = TILE.FREE;
      }
    }

    carveCell(nextCol, nextRow);
    visited.add(keyOf(nextCol, nextRow));
    stack.push([nextCol, nextRow]);
  }
}

function carveRoom(tiles, width, room) {
  for (let y = room.y; y < room.y + room.height; y += 1) {
    for (let x = room.x; x < room.x + room.width; x += 1) {
      tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
    }
  }
}

/** First index of a 2-wide band that still contains `center`, keeping a wall at the border. */
function bandStart(center, size) {
  return Math.min(Math.max(center, 1), size - 3);
}

function connectRooms(tiles, width, height, from, to) {
  const fromX = from.x + Math.floor(from.width / 2);
  const fromY = from.y + Math.floor(from.height / 2);
  const toX = to.x + Math.floor(to.width / 2);
  const toY = to.y + Math.floor(to.height / 2);

  // Both arms are two tiles thick. The horizontal arm spans the source room to
  // the destination column band, the vertical arm spans the horizontal band to
  // the destination room, and the overlap is a 2x2 corner.
  const row = bandStart(fromY, height);
  const column = bandStart(toX, width);
  const left = Math.min(fromX, column);
  const right = Math.max(fromX, column) + 1;
  const top = Math.min(row, toY);
  const bottom = Math.max(row + 1, toY);

  carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, row, right, row + 1);
  carveRectangle(tiles, width, column, top, column + 1, bottom);
}

function carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
  for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y += 1) {
    for (let x = left; x <= right; x += 1) {
      tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
    }
  }
}

function rollItemType(rng) {
  const total = ITEM_TYPES.reduce((sum, type) => sum + ITEM_WEIGHTS[type], 0);
  let roll = rng.next() * total;

  for (const type of ITEM_TYPES) {
    roll -= ITEM_WEIGHTS[type];
    if (roll < 0) {
      return type;
    }
  }

  return ITEM_TYPES[ITEM_TYPES.length - 1];
}

function scatterItems(rng, { tiles, spawnZones, width, height, count }) {
  const candidates = [];

  for (let y = 1; y < height - 1; y += 1) {
    for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x += 1) {
      const index = y * width + x;
      if (tiles[index] === TILE.FREE && spawnZones[index] === -1) {
        candidates.push({ x, y });
      }
    }
  }

  rng.shuffle(candidates);

  const items = [];
  const limit = Math.min(count, candidates.length);

  for (let index = 0; index < limit; index += 1) {
    items.push({
      id: index + 1,
      type: rollItemType(rng),
      x: candidates[index].x,
      y: candidates[index].y,
      taken: false,
    });
  }

  return items;
}

37: /** Small, fast, deterministic 32-bit PRNG. */
38: export function mulberry32(seed) {
39:   let state = seed >>> 0;
40:   return function next() {
41:     state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
42:     let t = state;
43:     t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
44:     t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
45:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
46:   };
47: }

49: export function makeRng(seed) {
50:   const next = mulberry32(seed);
51:   return {
52:     next,
53:     int(max) {
54:       return Math.floor(next() * max);
55:     },
56:     pick(list) {
57:       return list[this.int(list.length)];
58:     },
59:     shuffle(list) {
60:       for (let index = list.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
61:         const swap = this.int(index + 1);
62:         [list[index], list[swap]] = [list[swap], list[index]];
63:       }
64:       return list;
65:     },
66:   };
67: }

69: /**

73: export function bestRectangle(area) {
74:   if (!Number.isInteger(area) || area <= 0) {
75:     throw new RangeError('area must be a positive integer');
76:   }

78:   let best = null;

88:     if (best === null || diff < best.diff) {
89:       best = { width, height, diff };
90:     }
91:   }
92: 
93:   return { width: best.width, height: best.height };
94: }

107: /** Team index at a tile, or -1 for normal maze space. */
108: export function spawnTeamAt(maze, x, y) {
109:   if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= maze.width || y >= maze.height) {
110:     return -1;
111:   }
112:   return maze.spawnZones[y * maze.width + x];

115: export function generateMaze(options = {}) {
116:   const config = { ...MAZE_DEFAULTS, ...options };
117: 
118:   if (!Number.isInteger(config.width) || config.width < 9 || config.width % 2 === 0) {
119:     throw new RangeError('width must be an odd integer >= 9');
120:   }
121:   if (!Number.isInteger(config.height) || config.height < 9 || config.height % 2 === 0) {
122:     throw new RangeError('height must be an odd integer >= 9');
123:   }
124:   if (!Number.isInteger(config.teams) || config.teams < 2) {
125:     throw new RangeError('teams must be an integer >= 2');
126:   }
127:   if (!Number.isInteger(config.playersPerTeam) || config.playersPerTeam < 1) {
128:     throw new RangeError('playersPerTeam must be a positive integer');
129:   }
130:   if (!Number.isInteger(config.itemsPerTeam) || config.itemsPerTeam < 0) {
131:     throw new RangeError('itemsPerTeam must be a non-negative integer');
132:   }
133: 
134:   const rng = makeRng(config.seed);
135:   const { width, height } = config;
136:   const tiles = new Uint8Array(width * height).fill(TILE.WALL);
137:   const spawnZones = new Int16Array(width * height).fill(-1);
138: 
139:   const spawns = placeSpawnZones(rng, width, height, config.teams, config.playersPerTeam);
140:   carveMaze(rng, tiles, width, height);
141: 
142:   for (const zone of spawns) {
143:     carveRoom(tiles, width, zone);
144:     for (let y = zone.y; y < zone.y + zone.height; y += 1) {
145:       for (let x = zone.x; x < zone.x + zone.width; x += 1) {
146:         spawnZones[y * width + x] = zone.teamId;
147:       }
148:     }
149:   }
150: 
151:   // A corridor between every pair of rooms guarantees the spawns connect
152:   // even when the maze pass leaves a room sealed by walls.
153:   for (let index = 1; index < spawns.length; index += 1) {
154:     connectRooms(tiles, width, height, spawns[index - 1], spawns[index]);
155:   }
156: 
157:   const items = scatterItems(rng, {
158:     tiles,
159:     spawnZones,
160:     width,
161:     height,
162:     count: config.teams * config.itemsPerTeam,
163:   });
164: 
165:   return {
166:     width,
167:     height,
168:     tiles,
169:     spawnZones,
170:     spawns,
171:     items,
172:     seed: config.seed,
173:   };
174: }

176: function placeSpawnZones(rng, width, height, teams, playersPerTeam) {
177:   // Every room is at least 2x2 so no player ever stands in a one-tile pocket.
178:   const area = Math.max(4, playersPerTeam * 2);
179:   const { width: roomWidth, height: roomHeight } = bestRectangle(area);
180:   const zones = [];
181: 
182:   if (roomWidth + 2 >= width || roomHeight + 2 >= height) {
183:     throw new RangeError('map is too small for the spawn room size');
184:   }
185: 
186:   for (let teamId = 0; teamId < teams; teamId += 1) {
187:     let placed = null;
188: 
189:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 600 && !placed; attempt += 1) {
190:       const x = 1 + rng.int(width - roomWidth - 2);
191:       const y = 1 + rng.int(height - roomHeight - 2);
192: 
193:       if (x + roomWidth > width - 1 || y + roomHeight > height - 1) {
194:         continue;
195:       }
196: 
197:       const candidate = { x, y, width: roomWidth, height: roomHeight };
198: 
199:       if (zones.some((zone) => rectsOverlap(candidate, zone, 3))) {
200:         continue;
201:       }
202: 
203:       placed = candidate;
204:     }
205: 
206:     if (!placed) {
207:       throw new RangeError('map is too small for every spawn room');
208:     }
209: 
210:     zones.push({ teamId, ...placed });
211:   }
212: 
213:   return zones;
214: }
215: 
216: function rectsOverlap(a, b, padding) {
217:   return (
218:     a.x - padding < b.x + b.width &&
219:     a.x + a.width + padding > b.x &&
220:     a.y - padding < b.y + b.height &&
221:     a.y + a.height + padding > b.y
222:   );
223: }

225: function carveMaze(rng, tiles, width, height) {
226:   // Cells are 2x2 open rooms separated by one-tile walls, so every corridor
227:   // and junction is two tiles wide. Cell starts sit on 1 + 3 * index.
228:   const CELL_STEP = 3;
229:   const CELL_SIZE = 2;
230:   const cols = Math.floor((width - 4) / CELL_STEP) + 1;
231:   const rows = Math.floor((height - 4) / CELL_STEP) + 1;
232:   const cellX = (col) => 1 + col * CELL_STEP;
233:   const cellY = (row) => 1 + row * CELL_STEP;
234:   const keyOf = (col, row) => row * cols + col;
235:   const visited = new Set([keyOf(0, 0)]);
236:   const stack = [[0, 0]];
237: 
238:   const carveCell = (col, row) => {
239:     const startX = cellX(col);
240:     const startY = cellY(row);
241: 
242:     for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
243:       for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
244:         tiles[(startY + y) * width + startX + x] = TILE.FREE;
245:       }
246:     }
247:   };
248: 
249:   carveCell(0, 0);
250: 
251:   while (stack.length > 0) {
252:     const [col, row] = stack[stack.length - 1];
253:     const options = [];
254: 
255:     for (const [dc, dr] of [
256:       [0, -1],
257:       [0, 1],
258:       [-1, 0],
259:       [1, 0],
260:     ]) {
261:       const nextCol = col + dc;
262:       const nextRow = row + dr;
263: 
264:       if (nextCol < 0 || nextRow < 0 || nextCol >= cols || nextRow >= rows) {
265:         continue;
266:       }
267:       if (visited.has(keyOf(nextCol, nextRow))) {
268:         continue;
269:       }
270:       options.push([nextCol, nextRow, dc, dr]);
271:     }
272: 
273:     if (options.length === 0) {
274:       stack.pop();
275:       continue;
276:     }
277: 
278:     const [nextCol, nextRow, dc, dr] = options[rng.int(options.length)];
279: 
280:     // Remove the one-tile wall between the two 2x2 cells. Because the wall is
281:     // carved for both rows (or both columns), the opening stays two tiles wide.
282:     if (dc === 1) {
283:       for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
284:         tiles[(cellY(row) + y) * width + cellX(col) + CELL_SIZE] = TILE.FREE;
285:       }
286:     } else if (dc === -1) {
287:       for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
288:         tiles[(cellY(row) + y) * width + cellX(col) - 1] = TILE.FREE;
289:       }
290:     } else if (dr === 1) {
291:       for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
292:         tiles[(cellY(row) + CELL_SIZE) * width + cellX(col) + x] = TILE.FREE;
293:       }
294:     } else if (dr === -1) {
295:       for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
296:         tiles[(cellY(row) - 1) * width + cellX(col) + x] = TILE.FREE;
297:       }
298:     }
299: 
300:     carveCell(nextCol, nextRow);
301:     visited.add(keyOf(nextCol, nextRow));
302:     stack.push([nextCol, nextRow]);
303:   }
304: }
305: 
306: function carveRoom(tiles, width, room) {
307:   for (let y = room.y; y < room.y + room.height; y += 1) {
308:     for (let x = room.x; x < room.x + room.width; x += 1) {
309:       tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
310:     }
311:   }
312: }
313: 
314: /** First index of a 2-wide band that still contains `center`, keeping a wall at the border. */
315: function bandStart(center, size) {
316:   return Math.min(Math.max(center, 1), size - 3);
317: }
318: 
319: function connectRooms(tiles, width, height, from, to) {
320:   const fromX = from.x + Math.floor(from.width / 2);
321:   const fromY = from.y + Math.floor(from.height / 2);
322:   const toX = to.x + Math.floor(to.width / 2);
323:   const toY = to.y + Math.floor(to.height / 2);
324: 
325:   // Both arms are two tiles thick. The horizontal arm spans the source room to
326:   // the destination column band, the vertical arm spans the horizontal band to
327:   // the destination room, and the overlap is a 2x2 corner.
328:   const row = bandStart(fromY, height);
329:   const column = bandStart(toX, width);
330:   const left = Math.min(fromX, column);
331:   const right = Math.max(fromX, column) + 1;
332:   const top = Math.min(row, toY);
333:   const bottom = Math.max(row + 1, toY);
334: 
335:   carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, row, right, row + 1);
336:   carveRectangle(tiles, width, column, top, column + 1, bottom);
337: }
338: 
339: function carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
340:   for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y += 1) {
341:     for (let x = left; x <= right; x += 1) {
342:       tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
343:     }
344:   }
345: }
346: 
347: function rollItemType(rng) {
348:   const total = ITEM_TYPES.reduce((sum, type) => sum + ITEM_WEIGHTS[type], 0);
349:   let roll = rng.next() * total;
350: 
351:   for (const type of ITEM_TYPES) {
352:     roll -= ITEM_WEIGHTS[type];
353:     if (roll < 0) {
354:       return type;
355:     }
356:   }
357: 
358:   return ITEM_TYPES[ITEM_TYPES.length - 1];
359: }
360: 
361: function scatterItems(rng, { tiles, spawnZones, width, height, count }) {
362:   const candidates = [];
363: 
364:   for (let y = 1; y < height - 1; y += 1) {
365:     for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x += 1) {
366:       const index = y * width + x;
367:       if (tiles[index] === TILE.FREE && spawnZones[index] === -1) {
368:         candidates.push({ x, y });
369:       }
370:     }
371:   }
372: 
373:   rng.shuffle(candidates);
374: 
375:   const items = [];
376:   const limit = Math.min(count, candidates.length);
377: 
378:   for (let index = 0; index < limit; index += 1) {
379:     items.push({
380:       id: index + 1,
381:       type: rollItemType(rng),
382:       x: candidates[index].x,
383:       y: candidates[index].y,
384:       taken: false,
385:     });
386:   }
387: 
388:   return items;
389: }

168: function buildMazeBitmap() {

178:   for (let index = 0; index < tiles.length; index += 1) {

182:     if (tiles[index] === TILE.WALL) {
183:       data[offset] = 56;
184:       data[offset + 1] = 49;
185:       data[offset + 2] = 39;
186:     } else if (owner >= 0) {
187:       const color = teamColors[owner];
188:       data[offset] = Math.round(12 + color[0] * 0.32);
189:       data[offset + 1] = Math.round(10 + color[1] * 0.32);
190:       data[offset + 2] = Math.round(8 + color[2] * 0.32);
191:     } else {
192:       data[offset] = 14;
193:       data[offset + 1] = 12;
194:       data[offset + 2] = 10;
195:     }
196:     data[offset + 3] = 255;

199:   bitmapCtx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);

261:     clearInterval(pingTimer);

264:   return { httpServer, room };

267: export function startServer({ port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 8080, host = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0' } = {}) {
268:   const { httpServer, room } = createGameServer();
269: 
270:   httpServer.listen(port, host, () => {
271:     console.log(`commieD server listening on http://${host}:${port}`);
272:     console.log(`Open http://localhost:${port}/main-game/`);
273:     console.log(`Match seed ${room.game.seed}; ${room.options.teams} teams x ${room.options.playersPerTeam}.`);
274:   });
275: 
276:   const shutdown = () => {
277:     httpServer.close(() => process.exit(0));
278:     setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 2000).unref();
279:   };
280: 
281:   process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
282:   process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);
283: 
284:   return { httpServer, room };
285: }
286: 
287: const isMain = process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;
288: if (isMain) {
289:   startServer();

760: function edgePoint(rect, toward, pad = 7) {
761:   const center = centerOf(rect);
762:   const dx = toward.x - center.x;
763:   const dy = toward.y - center.y;

767:   if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) {

771:   const scaleX = dx === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : halfW / Math.abs(dx);
772:   const scaleY = dy === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : halfH / Math.abs(dy);
773:   const scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
774: 
775:   return {
776:     x: center.x + dx * scale,
777:     y: center.y + dy * scale,
778:   };
779: }

1210:     badge.textContent = '○';
1211:   }
1212:   clone.style.setProperty('--fill', '0%');
1213:   clone.style.setProperty('--liquid', 'transparent');
1214: 
1215:   track.append(clone);
1216: 
1217:   const travel = track.clientWidth + 80;
1218:   const duration = Math.max(900, (travel / 95) * 1000);
1219:   const animation = clone.animate(
1220:     [
1221:       { transform: 'translate(-12px, -68px) rotate(-9deg)' },
1222:       { transform: 'translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg)', offset: 0.1 },
1223:       { transform: `translate(${travel}px, 0) rotate(0deg)` },
1224:     ],
1225:     {
1226:       duration,
1227:       easing: 'linear',
1228:       fill: 'forwards',
1229:     },
1230:   );
1231: 
1232:   animation.finished.then(() => clone.remove()).catch(() => clone.remove());
1233: }
1234: 
1235: /* Vials are released one at a time as the active pot drains. */
1236: function spawnVial() {
1237:   if (reduceMotion) {
1238:     return;
1239:   }
1240: 
1241:   const track = stationViews.get('bottler')?.vialTrack;
1242:   if (!track) {
1243:     return;
1244:   }
1245: 
1246:   const vial = document.createElement('img');
1247:   vial.src = ASSETS.vial;
1248:   vial.alt = '';
1249:   vial.className = 'belt-vial';
1250:   track.append(vial);
1251: 
1252:   const travel = track.clientWidth + 40;
1253:   const duration = Math.max(1100, (travel / 110) * 1000);
1254:   const animation = vial.animate(
1255:     [
1256:       { transform: 'translate(-16px, 0)' },
1257:       { transform: `translate(${travel}px, 0)` },
1258:     ],
1259:     {
1260:       duration,
1261:       easing: 'linear',
1262:       fill: 'forwards',
1263:     },
1264:   );
1265: 
1266:   animation.finished.then(() => vial.remove()).catch(() => vial.remove());
1267: }
1268: 
1269: const vialEmitted = new Map();
1270: 
1271: function vialQuota(progressMs) {
1272:   const perVial = core.config.bottlingMs / core.config.vialsPerPot;
1273:   return Math.max(
1274:     0,
1275:     Math.min(
1276:       core.config.vialsPerPot,
1277:       Math.floor(progressMs / perVial + 1e-6),
1278:     ),
1279:   );
1280: }
1281: 
1282: function updateBottlingFlow() {
1283:   const active = core.pots.find(
1284:     (pot) =>
1285:       pot.location === 'bottler' && pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING,
1286:   );
1287: 
1288:   if (!active) {
1289:     return;
1290:   }
1291: 
1292:   const emitted = vialQuota(active.progressMs);
1293:   const previous = vialEmitted.get(active.id) ?? 0;
1294: 
1295:   if (emitted <= previous) {
1296:     return;
1297:   }
1298: 
1299:   for (let index = previous; index < emitted; index += 1) {
1300:     spawnVial();
1301:   }
1302:   vialEmitted.set(active.id, emitted);
1303: }
1304: 
1305: function handleEvents(events) {
1306:   for (const event of events) {
1307:     switch (event.type) {
1308:       case 'process-complete':
1309:         pulseStation(event.stationId);
1310:         break;
1311:       case 'pot-spoiled':
1312:         captureSpoiledFx(event.potId);
1313:         toast(
1314:           `Pot #${event.potId} spoiled at ${stationLabel(event.stationId)} — the timer ran out.`,
1315:         );
1316:         break;
1317:       case 'pot-bottled': {
1318:         const already = vialEmitted.get(event.potId) ?? 0;
1319:         const remaining = Math.max(0, event.vials - already);
1320:         for (let index = 0; index < remaining; index += 1) {
1321:           spawnVial();
1322:         }
1323:         vialEmitted.delete(event.potId);
1324:         sendPotDownEmpties(event.potId);
1325:         break;
1326:       }
1327:       default:
1328:         break;
1329:     }
1330:   }
1331: }

1366: function frame(now) {
1367:   const delta = Math.min(250, Math.max(0, now - lastFrame));
1368:   lastFrame = now;

1370:   if (!document.hidden && !embedded) {

406:   cursor: grab;
407:   touch-action: none;
408: }
409: 
410: .pot:focus-visible {
411:   outline: 2px solid var(--gold);
412:   outline-offset: 3px;
413: }
414: 
415: .pot.is-working,
416: .pot.is-bottling {
417:   cursor: default;
418: }
419: 
420: .pot__lid {
421:   flex: none;
422:   width: 38%;
423:   height: 4px;
424:   margin-bottom: 2px;
425:   border-radius: 2px 2px 1px 1px;
426:   background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a09780, #514b3e);
427:   box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
428: }
429: 
430: .pot__body {
431:   position: relative;
432:   display: flex;
433:   flex: 1;
434:   align-items: flex-end;
435:   width: 100%;
436:   overflow: hidden;
437:   border: 1px solid #1b1813;
438:   border-radius: 12% 12% 28% 28% / 6% 6% 24% 24%;
439:   background:
440:     linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09), transparent 30% 70%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)),
441:     linear-gradient(180deg, #625d4e, #2c2820);
442:   box-shadow:
443:     inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
444:     inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
445: }
446: 
447: .pot__liquid {
448:   width: 100%;
449:   height: var(--fill, 0%);
450:   background:
451:     linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), transparent 34%),
452:     var(--liquid, transparent);
453:   box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
454:   transition:
455:     height 0.18s linear,
456:     background-color 0.25s ease;
457: }
458: 
459: /* Empty pots sit in the intake as bright steel shells. */
460: 
461: .pot.is-empty .pot__body {
462:   border-color: #8b836e;
463:   background:
464:     linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.26), transparent 30% 70%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)),
465:     linear-gradient(180deg, #b0a890, #6d6655);
466:   box-shadow:
467:     inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22),
468:     inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45),
469:     0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
470: }
471: 
472: .pot.is-empty .pot__lid {
473:   background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d2c9b1, #766e5a);
474: }
475: 
476: .pot.is-empty .pot__badge {
477:   border-color: #766e5a;
478:   background: #28241b;
479:   color: #c9c0a6;
480: }
481: 
482: .pot__badge {
483:   position: absolute;
484:   top: -5px;
485:   right: -6px;
486:   z-index: 3;
487:   display: grid;
488:   place-items: center;
489:   min-width: 14px;
490:   height: 14px;
491:   padding: 0 3px;
492:   border: 1px solid #504834;
493:   border-radius: 999px;
494:   background: #100e09;
495:   color: #c9c0a6;
496:   font-size: 7.5px;
497:   font-weight: 700;
498:   line-height: 1;
499:   letter-spacing: 0.02em;
500: }
501: 
502: .pot.is-ready .pot__badge {
503:   border-color: var(--gold);
504:   background: #2b2410;
505:   color: var(--gold-soft);
506:   box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.45);
507: }
508: 
509: .pot.is-bottling .pot__badge {
510:   border-color: #9c7b1e;
511:   color: var(--gold);
512: }
513: 
514: /* Pots waiting their turn in the bottler stay full and dimmed. */
515: 
516: .pot.is-queued {
517:   opacity: 0.62;
518: }
519: 
520: .pot.is-queued .pot__badge {
521:   border-color: #6b6351;
522:   color: #b0a78e;
523: }
524: 
525: /* While the bottler drains a pot, its liquid visibly falls and bubbles. */
526: 
527: .pot.is-bottling .pot__body {
528:   border-color: #9c7b1e;
529:   box-shadow:
530:     0 0 0 1px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.18),
531:     0 0 12px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.18),
532:     inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
533: }
534: 
535: .pot.is-bottling .pot__liquid {
536:   position: relative;
537:   overflow: hidden;
538:   animation: bottling-glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
539: }
540: 
541: .pot.is-bottling .pot__liquid::after {
542:   content: "";
543:   position: absolute;
544:   inset: 0;
545:   background-image:
546:     radial-gradient(circle at 24% 100%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 0 1px, transparent 1.8px),
547:     radial-gradient(circle at 68% 100%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42) 0 1px, transparent 1.6px);
548:   background-repeat: repeat;
549:   background-size: 9px 11px, 13px 9px;
550:   animation: bottling-bubbles 0.9s linear infinite;
551: }
552: 
553: .pot__meter {
554:   position: absolute;
555:   right: 1px;
556:   bottom: -7px;
557:   left: 1px;
558:   height: 3px;
559:   overflow: hidden;
560:   border-radius: 2px;
561:   background: #0a0805;
562:   box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
563: }
564: 
565: .pot__meter-fill {
566:   width: var(--meter, 0%);
567:   height: 100%;
568:   border-radius: inherit;
569:   background: var(--meter-color, var(--green));
570:   transition:
571:     width 0.08s linear,
572:     background-color 0.18s ease;
573: }
574: 
575: .pot.is-empty .pot__meter {
576:   opacity: 0;
577: }
578: 
579: .pot.is-ready {
580:   animation: pot-ready 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
581: }
582: 
583: .pot.is-ready .pot__body {
584:   border-color: #9d822e;
585:   box-shadow:
586:     0 0 0 1px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.2),
587:     0 0 14px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.24),
588:     inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
589: }
590: 
591: .pot.is-warning .pot__meter-fill {
592:   background: #dd9d34;
593: }
594: 
595: .pot.is-urgent .pot__meter-fill {
596:   background: var(--red);
597: }
598: 
599: .pot.is-urgent {
600:   animation: pot-urgent 0.4s ease-in-out infinite;
601: }
602: 
603: .pot.is-dragging-source {
604:   opacity: 0.25;
605: }

607: /* ---------- Intake ---------- */
608: 
609: .intake {
610:   position: absolute;
611:   top: var(--intake-y, 16%);
612:   left: var(--intake-x, 8%);
613:   z-index: 4;
614:   width: 168px;
615:   padding-top: 28px;
616:   transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

620: .intake__machine {
621:   position: absolute;
622:   top: 0;

625:   z-index: 2;

628:   gap: 6px;
629:   height: 40px;
630:   padding: 0 8px;
631:   border: 1px solid #b49b5d;
632:   border-bottom: 0;

635:     linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 42%),

651: .intake__icon svg {
652:   width: 20px;
653:   height: 20px;
654:   fill: none;
655:   stroke: currentColor;
656:   stroke-linecap: round;
657:   stroke-linejoin: round;
658:   stroke-width: 1.5;

660: 
661: .intake__titles {
662:   min-width: 0;
663: }
664: 
665: .intake__eyebrow {
666:   display: block;
667:   color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);

672: 
673: .intake__title {
674:   margin: 0;
675:   color: #f2ead8;
676:   font-size: 8.5px;

678:   white-space: nowrap;

681: .intake__lamp {
682:   margin-left: auto;
683: }
684: 
685: .intake__rack {
686:   display: grid;
687:   grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

689:   min-height: 72px;

691:   padding: 7px;
692:   overflow-y: auto;
693:   border: 1px solid #423b2e;

696:     linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035), transparent 30%),
697:     linear-gradient(180deg, #252118, #12100b);
698:   box-shadow:
699:     inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06),
700:     0 14px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48);

705:   display: block;

708: .intake__rack.is-empty::after {

711:   min-height: 58px;
712:   place-items: center;

714:   font-size: 7.5px;
715:   letter-spacing: 0.14em;

719: .intake__rack .pot {

723: .take-pot {

731:   border-radius: 6px;

733:     linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.2), rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.06)),
734:     #19150b;
735:   color: var(--gold-soft);
736:   font-size: 8px;
737:   letter-spacing: 0.15em;
738:   cursor: pointer;
739:   transition:
740:     background 0.15s ease,
741:     border-color 0.15s ease,
742:     transform 0.1s ease;

744: 
745: .take-pot:hover {
746:   border-color: var(--gold);
747:   background:
748:     linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.32), rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.1)),
749:     #19150b;

751: 
752: .take-pot:active {
753:   transform: translateY(1px);
754: }
755: 
756: .take-pot strong {
757:   color: var(--gold);
758:   font-size: 10px;
759:   font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

961:

1017:   border-bottom: 1px solid #302b21;

1019:   font-size: 7px;
1020:   letter-spacing: 0.08em;

1022: 
1023: .stat {
1024:   display: flex;

1067:   border-left: 2px solid transparent;
1068:   border-radius: 3px;
1069:   color: #8c836e;

1071:   letter-spacing: 0.03em;

1073:     background 0.15s ease,
1074:     color 0.15s ease,
1075:     border-color 0.15s ease;

1078: .plan-step__num {
1079:   color: #6b6455;
1080:   font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

1086:   white-space: nowrap;
1087: }
1088: 
1089: .plan-step__station {
1090:   color: #5d5748;
1091:   font-size: 6px;
1092:   letter-spacing: 0.06em;
1093: }
1094: 
1095: .plan-step.is-live {
1096:   border-left-color: var(--gold);
1097:   background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.08);
1098:   color: var(--gold-soft);
1099: }
1100: 
1101: .plan-step.is-live .plan-step__num,
1102: .plan-step.is-live .plan-step__station {
1103:   color: var(--gold);
1104: }
1105: 
1106: .hint {
1107:   min-height: 24px;
1108:   margin: 8px 0 0;
1109:   padding-top: 7px;
1110:   border-top: 1px solid #302b21;

1112:   font-size: 9px;
1113:   line-height: 1.4;
1114:   letter-spacing: 0.02em;

1116:

15: 02actual gameplay
16: - the entire game happens in a limited procedurally generated maze.
17: - each team begins in a large empty space surrounded by the maze. which is its spawn point. enemies cannot enter here. and spawn vulnerability is also here. 
18: - the whole game is top down 2d.
19: - the screen will consist of the following:
20: .top left=minimap which will either show the nearby area, minimap of the whole maze or a list of your teammates which you can quickly select from by using arrow keys to get the route to them.(these different modes can be switched by using x key)
21: .top center=performance and connection stats. strip format. with colour change for good, acceptable and bad stat values.
22: .bottom left=team reserves(ammo, dash, current powerup)
23: .bottom center=team health
24: .top right=comrats(stats of your comrades)
25: - you move around with wasd and arrowkeys, shift to dash. mouse to aim and click to shoot. hold click to for continuous fire. space for using special item
26: - special items are found around the world as collectibles strewn around in mazes
27: - the maze itself is a tiled system containing the following types of tiles: wall, free space,. this is saved and used by program with the help of a 1d array whose scale is fixed at a square for now.
28: - for ghosts, they can immediately switch between different tasks by using 1,2,3(clicker,ammo,dash)
29: - special items that can be triggered with space are 1 time and everyone gets the special item. in case more are collected, they become the current special item and the item before it is saved and becomes current item again when special items is empty. anybody can use this item and exhaust it for the entire team.(communism at peak).
30: - special items cannot be stacked. one can only be triggered when there are no current effects. effects are applied teamwide when triggered.
31: -special items can randomly spawn on any free 
32: 03maze design:
33: - the maze is a structure with large spaces for the team spawn points.
34: - it will be a 3 pass system. first randomly set the spawn areas fo the different teams, then generate the maze then at last generate the special items.
35: - each tile is the same size as the player. the player is a circle with 1 pointed end. acting as gunpoint.
36: - the spawnpoint area is calculated as the sum of all the tiles per player(2 tiles per player). converted into a rectangle where the length and breadth have least difference.

1: # commieD-Idea
2: 
3: - Multiplayer maze shooter (browser-based)
4: - Large scale: 1000s of concurrent players across 200 cities globally
5: - Goal: be the last team standing
6: -the entire game is minimal in design and assets with the theme of communism(cause commieD=comm(unist)i(com)eD(y))
7: - Teams are divided uniformly.
8: - Teams share everything(from ammo, dashes, and even HP)
9: - If the team HP goes to 0, the entire team dies.
10: - on a team dying, only the n/2 best players will be revived with team hp also getting halved(number of plrs\*hp per players= team HP, simpool)
11: - dead players(the n/2 not selected to play), act as ghosts, who search and collect resources for the team.
12: - on the number of players in team reaching one, the team dies. and is eliminated.
13: 04 — ghost mode
14: - the ghosts will play minigames to earn resources 
15:      a clicker game where you need to "CONTRIBUTE" your soul to your comrades(communist game intensifies). To create 
16: 04 — Ghost Mode
17: - Players who aren't selected for revival become ghosts.
18: - Ghosts continue contributing to their team's survival.
19: - Ghosts can collect resources for their team.
20: - Ghosts can play minigames to generate resources.
21: - Different resource types have different minigames.
22: - Ghosts can choose which resource they want to contribute.
23: 05 — Soul Contribution
24: - Soul is a resource generated by ghosts through a clicker minigame.
25: - Ghosts click the central soul sprite to contribute their souls to their comrades.
26: - Souls are converted into HP and added to the team's health pool.
27: - The clicking rate (CPS) is measured over a rolling 10-second window.
28: - At 5 CPS or more, a ghost generates 0.2 × CPS HP/s; exactly 5 CPS is 1 HP/s.
29: - Below 5 CPS, team HP drops by 0.2 HP/s.
30: - Generated HP is banked until living players need it, with no maximum cap.
31: - The HP bar is red below 100 × living teammates, yellow up to that baseline + 90, and green above.
32: - Random shapes appear every 10–30 seconds; clicking one grants +5 HP.
33: - Ghost-generated HP is used when living players have low health.
34: - Q pauses and resumes the minigame.
35: Health regeneration rules
36: - Teams without ghosts regenerate HP normally.
37: - Normal regeneration happens at a fixed rate.
38: - Normal regeneration does not happen instantly.
39: - Teams with ghosts cannot regenerate HP normally.
40: - Teams with ghosts depend on ghost-generated HP instead.
41: 06 — Bullet Press
42: - Follow keyboard instructions to create magazines.
43: - One sequence fills one magazine; a sequence is 10 characters drawn from A–Z, typed in order.
44: - A correct key fills the next slot green; a wrong key fills it red and marks the whole magazine broken.
45: - A broken magazine cannot be discarded; it stays until all 10 slots are filled, then produces nothing.
46: - The entire sequence must be completed for the next magazine run.
47: - A perfect magazine produces magazines equal to the multiplier.
48: - The multiplier is a whole number from 1x to 5x based on average time per key: ≤400 ms is x5, ≤600 ms x4, ≤800 ms x3, ≤1100 ms x2, slower x1.
49: - A broken magazine awards x0 and increments the broken count.
50: - Finished magazines eject to the right and the next empty magazine enters from the left.
51: - takeMagazines() returns whole magazines to the team.
52: 07 --speed dash supplement factory:
53: - A station-management factory game that produces dash seconds.
54: - Take empty pots from the unlimited intake and drag them through twelve numbered processes over six reusable stations.
55: - Each station holds four pots in a 2×2 grid and processes automatically; a pot must be moved before its ready window expires or it spoils and frees its slot.
56: - A pot can only enter the station for its current process; wrong-station drops are rejected for free.
57: - Process 12 must finish before the bottler accepts the pot.
58: - The bottler holds four pots and empties them one at a time over ten seconds each; waiting pots queue.
59: - One pot produces 20 vials; one vial is one second of dash.
60: - Vials ride the upper outfeed belt as the pot drains; the emptied pot rides the lower belt away.
61: - takeVials() / takeSeconds() return the produced dash to the team.

37: /** Small, fast, deterministic 32-bit PRNG. */
38: export function mulberry32(seed) {
39:   let state = seed >>> 0;
40:   return function next() {
41:     state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
42:     let t = state;
43:     t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
44:     t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
45:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
46:   };
47: }

49: export function makeRng(seed) {
50:   const next = mulberry32(seed);
51:   return {
52:     next,
53:     int(max) {
54:       return Math.floor(next() * max);
55:     },
56:     pick(list) {
57:       return list[this.int(list.length)];
58:     },
59:     shuffle(list) {
60:       for (let index = list.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
61:         const swap = this.int(index + 1);
62:         [list[index], list[swap]] = [list[swap], list[index]];
63:       }
64:       return list;
65:     },
66:   };
67: }

69: /**
70:  * Convert an area into the rectangle with the closest matching sides.
71:  * 16 -> 4x4, 12 -> 4x3, 7 -> 7x1.
72:  */
73: export function bestRectangle(area) {
74:   if (!Number.isInteger(area) || area <= 0) {
75:     throw new RangeError('area must be a positive integer');
76:   }
77: 
78:   let best = null;
79: 
80:   for (let height = 1; height * height <= area; height += 1) {
81:     if (area % height !== 0) {
82:       continue;
83:     }
84: 
85:     const width = area / height;
86:     const diff = width - height;
87: 
88:     if (best === null || diff < best.diff) {
89:       best = { width, height, diff };
90:     }

167:     height,
168:     tiles,
169:     spawnZones,

176: function placeSpawnZones(rng, width, height, teams, playersPerTeam) {
177:   // Every room is at least 2x2 so no player ever stands in a one-tile pocket.
178:   const area = Math.max(4, playersPerTeam * 2);
179:   const { width: roomWidth, height: roomHeight } = bestRectangle(area);
180:   const zones = [];
181: 
182:   if (roomWidth + 2 >= width || roomHeight + 2 >= height) {
183:     throw new RangeError('map is too small for the spawn room size');
184:   }
185: 
186:   for (let teamId = 0; teamId < teams; teamId += 1) {
187:     let placed = null;
188: 
189:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 600 && !placed; attempt += 1) {
190:       const x = 1 + rng.int(width - roomWidth - 2);
191:       const y = 1 + rng.int(height - roomHeight - 2);
192: 
193:       if (x + roomWidth > width - 1 || y + roomHeight > height - 1) {
194:         continue;
195:       }
196: 
197:       const candidate = { x, y, width: roomWidth, height: roomHeight };
198: 
199:       if (zones.some((zone) => rectsOverlap(candidate, zone, 3))) {
200:         continue;
201:       }
202: 
203:       placed = candidate;
204:     }
205: 
206:     if (!placed) {
207:       throw new RangeError('map is too small for every spawn room');
208:     }
209: 
210:     zones.push({ teamId, ...placed });
211:   }
212: 
213:   return zones;
214: }

216: function rectsOverlap(a, b, padding) {
217:   return (
218:     a.x - padding < b.x + b.width &&
219:     a.x + a.width + padding > b.x &&
220:     a.y - padding < b.y + b.height &&
221:     a.y + a.height + padding > b.y
222:   );
223: }

225: function carveMaze(rng, tiles, width, height) {
226:   // Cells are 2x2 open rooms separated by one-tile walls, so every corridor
227:   // and junction is two tiles wide. Cell starts sit on 1 + 3 * index.
228:   const CELL_STEP = 3;
229:   const CELL_SIZE = 2;
230:   const cols = Math.floor((width - 4) / CELL_STEP) + 1;
231:   const rows = Math.floor((height - 4) / CELL_STEP) + 1;
232:   const cellX = (col) => 1 + col * CELL_STEP;
233:   const cellY = (row) => 1 + row * CELL_STEP;
234:   const keyOf = (col, row) => row * cols + col;
235:   const visited = new Set([keyOf(0, 0)]);
236:   const stack = [[0, 0]];
237: 
238:   const carveCell = (col, row) => {
239:     const startX = cellX(col);
240:     const startY = cellY(row);
241: 
242:     for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
243:       for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
244:         tiles[(startY + y) * width + startX + x] = TILE.FREE;
245:       }
246:     }
247:   };
248: 
249:   carveCell(0, 0);
250: 
251:   while (stack.length > 0) {
252:     const [col, row] = stack[stack.length - 1];
253:     const options = [];
254: 
255:     for (const [dc, dr] of [
256:       [0, -1],
257:       [0, 1],
258:       [-1, 0],
259:       [1, 0],
260:     ]) {
261:       const nextCol = col + dc;
262:       const nextRow = row + dr;
263: 
264:       if (nextCol < 0 || nextRow < 0 || nextCol >= cols || nextRow >= rows) {
265:         continue;
266:       }
267:       if (visited.has(keyOf(nextCol, nextRow))) {
268:         continue;
269:       }
270:       options.push([nextCol, nextRow, dc, dr]);
271:     }
272: 
273:     if (options.length === 0) {
274:       stack.pop();
275:       continue;
276:     }
277: 
278:     const [nextCol, nextRow, dc, dr] = options[rng.int(options.length)];
279: 
280:     // Remove the one-tile wall between the two 2x2 cells. Because the wall is
281:     // carved for both rows (or both columns), the opening stays two tiles wide.
282:     if (dc === 1) {
283:       for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
284:         tiles[(cellY(row) + y) * width + cellX(col) + CELL_SIZE] = TILE.FREE;
285:       }
286:     } else if (dc === -1) {
287:       for (let y = 0; y < CELL_SIZE; y += 1) {
288:         tiles[(cellY(row) + y) * width + cellX(col) - 1] = TILE.FREE;
289:       }
290:     } else if (dr === 1) {
291:       for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
292:         tiles[(cellY(row) + CELL_SIZE) * width + cellX(col) + x] = TILE.FREE;
293:       }
294:     } else if (dr === -1) {
295:       for (let x = 0; x < CELL_SIZE; x += 1) {
296:         tiles[(cellY(row) - 1) * width + cellX(col) + x] = TILE.FREE;
297:       }
298:     }
299: 
300:     carveCell(nextCol, nextRow);
301:     visited.add(keyOf(nextCol, nextRow));
302:     stack.push([nextCol, nextRow]);
303:   }
304: }
305: 
306: function carveRoom(tiles, width, room) {
307:   for (let y = room.y; y < room.y + room.height; y += 1) {
308:     for (let x = room.x; x < room.x + room.width; x += 1) {
309:       tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
310:     }
311:   }
312: }
313: 
314: /** First index of a 2-wide band that still contains `center`, keeping a wall at the border. */
315: function bandStart(center, size) {
316:   return Math.min(Math.max(center, 1), size - 3);
317: }
318: 
319: function connectRooms(tiles, width, height, from, to) {
320:   const fromX = from.x + Math.floor(from.width / 2);
321:   const fromY = from.y + Math.floor(from.height / 2);
322:   const toX = to.x + Math.floor(to.width / 2);
323:   const toY = to.y + Math.floor(to.height / 2);
324: 
325:   // Both arms are two tiles thick. The horizontal arm spans the source room to
326:   // the destination column band, the vertical arm spans the horizontal band to
327:   // the destination room, and the overlap is a 2x2 corner.
328:   const row = bandStart(fromY, height);
329:   const column = bandStart(toX, width);
330:   const left = Math.min(fromX, column);
331:   const right = Math.max(fromX, column) + 1;
332:   const top = Math.min(row, toY);
333:   const bottom = Math.max(row + 1, toY);
334: 
335:   carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, row, right, row + 1);
336:   carveRectangle(tiles, width, column, top, column + 1, bottom);
337: }
338: 
339: function carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
340:   for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y += 1) {
341:     for (let x = left; x <= right; x += 1) {
342:       tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
343:     }
344:   }
345: }
346: 
347: function rollItemType(rng) {
348:   const total = ITEM_TYPES.reduce((sum, type) => sum + ITEM_WEIGHTS[type], 0);
349:   let roll = rng.next() * total;
350: 
351:   for (const type of ITEM_TYPES) {
352:     roll -= ITEM_WEIGHTS[type];
353:     if (roll < 0) {
354:       return type;
355:     }
356:   }
357: 
358:   return ITEM_TYPES[ITEM_TYPES.length - 1];
359: }
360: 
361: function scatterItems(rng, { tiles, spawnZones, width, height, count }) {
362:   const candidates = [];
363: 
364:   for (let y = 1; y < height - 1; y += 1) {
365:     for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x += 1) {
366:       const index = y * width + x;
367:       if (tiles[index] === TILE.FREE && spawnZones[index] === -1) {
368:         candidates.push({ x, y });
369:       }
370:     }
371:   }
372: 
373:   rng.shuffle(candidates);
374: 
375:   const items = [];
376:   const limit = Math.min(count, candidates.length);
377: 
378:   for (let index = 0; index < limit; index += 1) {
379:     items.push({
380:       id: index + 1,
381:       type: rollItemType(rng),
382:       x: candidates[index].x,
383:       y: candidates[index].y,
384:       taken: false,
385:     });
386:   }
387: 
388:   return items;
389: }

397: function flyBullet(correct, startRect, endRect) {

407:     endRect.left + endRect.width / 2 - (startRect.left + startRect.width / 2);
408:   const dy = endRect.top + endRect.height / 2 - (startRect.top + startRect.height / 2);
409:   const scaleX = endRect.width / startRect.width;
410:   const scaleY = endRect.height / startRect.height;
411: 
412:   const animation = rect.animate(
413:     [
414:       { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)', opacity: 1 },
415:       { transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px) scale(${scaleX}, ${scaleY})`, opacity: 1 },
416:     ],
417:     { duration: FLY_DURATION_MS, easing: 'ease-in' },

136:     if (!team) {
137:       throw new RangeError('no open team');

275:   contribute(teamId, resources = {}) {

168: function buildMazeBitmap() {
169:   const { width, height, tiles, spawnZones } = game.maze;
170:   mazeBitmap = document.createElement('canvas');
171:   mazeBitmap.width = width;
172:   mazeBitmap.height = height;
173:   const bitmapCtx = mazeBitmap.getContext('2d');
174:   const image = bitmapCtx.createImageData(width, height);
175:   const data = image.data;
176:   const teamColors = game.teams.map((team) => hexToRgb(team.color));
177: 
178:   for (let index = 0; index < tiles.length; index += 1) {
179:     const offset = index * 4;
180:     const owner = spawnZones[index];
181: 
182:     if (tiles[index] === TILE.WALL) {
183:       data[offset] = 56;
184:       data[offset + 1] = 49;
185:       data[offset + 2] = 39;
186:     } else if (owner >= 0) {
187:       const color = teamColors[owner];
188:       data[offset] = Math.round(12 + color[0] * 0.32);
189:       data[offset + 1] = Math.round(10 + color[1] * 0.32);
190:       data[offset + 2] = Math.round(8 + color[2] * 0.32);
191:     } else {
192:       data[offset] = 14;
193:       data[offset + 1] = 12;
194:       data[offset + 2] = 10;
195:     }
196:     data[offset + 3] = 255;
197:   }
198: 
199:   bitmapCtx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
200: }

202: function hexToRgb(hex) {

206:     parseInt(value.slice(2, 4), 16),
207:     parseInt(value.slice(4, 6), 16),
208:   ];
209: }

253: function frame(now) {
254:   requestAnimationFrame(frame);
255: 
256:   const delta = lastFrame === 0 ? 16 : Math.min(100, now - lastFrame);
257:   lastFrame = now;
258: 
259:   fpsFrames += 1;
260:   fpsTime += delta;
261:   if (fpsTime >= 500) {
262:     fps = (fpsFrames * 1000) / fpsTime;
263:     frameMs = fpsTime / fpsFrames;
264:     fpsFrames = 0;
265:     fpsTime = 0;
266:   }
267: 
268:   if (!document.hidden) {
269:     if (NETWORK) {
270:       if (networkJoined && me) {
271:         interpolateNetwork();
272:         sendNetworkInput(now);
273:       }
274:     } else if (game) {
275:       const inputs = bots.inputs();
276:       if (me) {
277:         inputs.set(me.id, playerInput());
278:       }
279: 
280:       const result = game.step(delta, inputs);
281:       handleEvents(result.events);
282:       specialRequested = false;
283:       advanceLocalFactory(delta);
284:       updateLocalGhostConsole();
285:     }
286:   }
287: 
288:   if (me) {
289:     const follow = me.isGhost ? 0.12 : 0.2;
290:     camera.x += (me.x - camera.x) * follow;
291:     camera.y += (me.y - camera.y) * follow;
292:   }
293: 
294:   render(now);
295:   updateHud(now, delta);
296: }

298: function sendNetworkInput(now) {

301:   }

303: 
304:   const input = playerInput();
305:   net.send({ type: 'input', ...input });
306:   specialRequested = false;
307: }

309: function interpolateNetwork() {
310:   const factor = 0.35;
311: 
312:   for (const player of game.players) {
313:     player.x += (player.targetX - player.x) * factor;
314:     player.y += (player.targetY - player.y) * factor;
315:     const diff = Math.atan2(
316:       Math.sin(player.targetAngle - player.angle),
317:       Math.cos(player.targetAngle - player.angle),
318:     );
319:     player.angle += diff * factor;
320:   }
321: 
322:   for (const bullet of game.bullets) {
323:     bullet.x += (bullet.targetX - bullet.x) * 0.5;
324:     bullet.y += (bullet.targetY - bullet.y) * 0.5;
325:   }
326: 
327:   for (const bomb of game.bombs) {
328:     bomb.x += (bomb.targetX - bomb.x) * 0.5;
329:     bomb.y += (bomb.targetY - bomb.y) * 0.5;
330:   }
331: }

333: function advanceLocalFactory(delta) {
334:   if (!localFactory || !game || !me) {
335:     return;
336:   }
337: 
338:   const result = localFactory.advance(delta);
339: 
340:   for (const event of result.events) {
341:     if (event.type === 'pot-bottled') {
342:       game.contribute(me.teamId, { dashSeconds: event.seconds });
343:       toast(`DASH SUPPLEMENT BOTTLED — +${event.seconds}s TO THE TEAM`, 'good');
344:     }
345:   }
346: }

638: function contributeFromGhost({ game: source, resources = {} }) {
639:   if (NETWORK) {
640:     net?.send({ type: 'contribute', game: source, resources });
641:     return;
642:   }
643: 
644:   if (!me || me.alive || game.teams[me.teamId].eliminated) {
645:     return;
646:   }
647: 
648:   const hp = Number(resources.hp ?? 0);
649:   const ammo = Number(resources.ammo ?? 0);
650:   const dashSeconds = Number(resources.dashSeconds ?? 0);
651: 
652:   if (![hp, ammo, dashSeconds].every(Number.isFinite)) {
653:     return;
654:   }
655:   if (hp < 0) {
656:     const result = game.drainHp(me.teamId, -hp);
657:     handleEvents(result.events);
658:   } else {
659:     game.contribute(me.teamId, {
660:       hp: Math.max(0, hp),
661:       ammo: Math.max(0, ammo),
662:       dashSeconds: Math.max(0, dashSeconds),
663:     });
664:   }
665: }

325:   // Both arms are two tiles thick. The horizontal arm spans the source room to

328:   const row = bandStart(fromY, height);
329:   const column = bandStart(toX, width);

331:   const right = Math.max(fromX, column) + 1;

342:       tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
343:     }
344:   }

347: function rollItemType(rng) {

351:   for (const type of ITEM_TYPES) {
352:     roll -= ITEM_WEIGHTS[type];

355:     }
356:   }
357: 
358:   return ITEM_TYPES[ITEM_TYPES.length - 1];

361: function scatterItems(rng, { tiles, spawnZones, width, height, count }) {
362:   const candidates = [];
363: 
364:   for (let y = 1; y < height - 1; y += 1) {
365:     for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x += 1) {
366:       const index = y * width + x;
367:       if (tiles[index] === TILE.FREE && spawnZones[index] === -1) {
368:         candidates.push({ x, y });
369:       }
370:     }
371:   }
372: 
373:   rng.shuffle(candidates);
374: 
375:   const items = [];
376:   const limit = Math.min(count, candidates.length);
377: 
378:   for (let index = 0; index < limit; index += 1) {
379:     items.push({
380:       id: index + 1,
381:       type: rollItemType(rng),
382:       x: candidates[index].x,
383:       y: candidates[index].y,
384:       taken: false,
385:     });
386:   }
387: 
388:   return items;

441: 
442: function applyRemoteFactory(factory) {
443:   const previous = lastRemoteFactory;
444: 
445:   core.hydrate(factory);
446:   remoteOwners = new Map(
447:     Object.entries(factory?.owners ?? {}).map(([potId, owner]) => [Number(potId), owner]),
448:   );
449:   remoteCursors = new Map(
450:     (factory?.cursors ?? []).map((cursor) => [cursor.clientId, cursor]),
451:   );
452: 
453:   if (previous) {
454:     const spoiled =
455:       Math.max(0, Number(factory?.potsSpoiled) || 0) -
456:       Math.max(0, Number(previous.potsSpoiled) || 0);
457:     if (spoiled > 0) {
458:       toast(`A pot spoiled — ${spoiled} lost this shift.`);
459:     }
460: 
461:     const vials =
462:       Math.max(0, Number(factory?.vialsProduced) || 0) -
463:       Math.max(0, Number(previous.vialsProduced) || 0);
464:     if (vials > 0) {
465:       for (let index = 0; index < Math.min(20, vials); index += 1) {
466:         spawnVial();
467:       }
468:     }
469:   }
470: 
471:   lastRemoteFactory = factory;
472:   render();
473:   renderRemoteCursors();
474: }
475: 
476: function renderRemoteCursors() {
477:   if (!ui.cursors) {
478:     return;
479:   }
480: 
481:   const cursors = [];
482: 
483:   for (const cursor of remoteCursors.values()) {
484:     if (cursor.clientId === remoteClientId) {
485:       continue;
486:     }
487: 
488:     const el = document.createElement('div');
489:     el.className = 'remote-cursor';
490:     el.classList.toggle('is-active', Boolean(cursor.active));
491:     el.style.left = `${(Number(cursor.x) || 0) * 100}%`;
492:     el.style.top = `${(Number(cursor.y) || 0) * 100}%`;
493: 
494:     const tag = document.createElement('span');
495:     tag.className = 'remote-cursor__name';
496:     tag.textContent = cursor.name ?? 'COMRADE';
497:     el.append(tag);
498:     cursors.push(el);
499:   }
500: 
501:   // A claimed pot follows its owner's cursor, so teammates watch the same
502:   // movement without waiting for the drop snapshot.
503:   for (const [potId, owner] of remoteOwners) {
504:     if (owner.clientId === remoteClientId) {
505:       continue;
506:     }
507: 
508:     const cursor = remoteCursors.get(owner.clientId);
509:     const pot = findPot(potId);
510:     if (!cursor?.active || !pot || !isDraggable(pot)) {
511:       continue;
512:     }
513: 
514:     const ghost = createPotElement(pot);
515:     ghost.classList.add('remote-pot');
516:     ghost.disabled = true;
517:     ghost.style.left = `${(Number(cursor.x) || 0) * 100}%`;
518:     ghost.style.top = `${(Number(cursor.y) || 0) * 100}%`;
519:     cursors.push(ghost);
520:   }
521: 
522:   ui.cursors.replaceChildren(...cursors);
523: }
524: 
525: window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
526:   if (!embedded || event.origin !== window.location.origin) {
527:     return;
528:   }
529: 
530:   const data = event.data;
531:   if (!data || data.type !== 'state') {
532:     return;
533:   }
534: 
535:   if (Number.isInteger(data.clientId)) {
536:     remoteClientId = data.clientId;
537:   }
538:   if (data.factory) {
539:     applyRemoteFactory(data.factory);
540:   }
541: });

543: /* ---------- Render ---------- */
544: 
545: function renderHud() {
546:   const active = core.activePots;
547:   const ready = active.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY);
548:   const running = active.some(
549:     (pot) =>
550:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING ||
551:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING,
552:   );
553: 
554:   ui.emptiesCount.textContent = String(core.intakePots.length);
555:   ui.activeStat.textContent = String(active.length);
556:   ui.vialsStat.textContent = String(core.vialsProduced);
557:   ui.dashStat.textContent = `${core.secondsProduced}s`;
558:   ui.spoiledStat.textContent = String(core.potsSpoiled);
559:   ui.lamp.classList.toggle('is-ready', ready);
560:   ui.lamp.classList.toggle('is-run', !ready && running);
561: }
562: 
563: function renderIntake() {
564:   const pots = core.intakePots;
565:   ui.intakeRack.replaceChildren(...pots.map(createPotElement));
566:   ui.intakeRack.classList.toggle('is-empty', pots.length === 0);
567: }
568: 
569: function createSlots(pots, capacity) {
570:   const slots = [];
571: 
572:   for (let index = 0; index < capacity; index += 1) {
573:     const slot = document.createElement('div');
574:     slot.className = 'slot';
575:     if (pots[index]) {
576:       slot.classList.add('has-pot');
577:       slot.append(createPotElement(pots[index]));
578:     }
579:     slots.push(slot);
580:   }
581: 
582:   return slots;
583: }
584: 
585: function renderStations() {
586:   for (const station of core.stations) {
587:     const view = stationViews.get(station.id);
588:     const pots = core.getPotsAt(station.id);
589: 
590:     view.slots.replaceChildren(...createSlots(pots, view.capacity));
591:     view.count.textContent = `${pots.length} / ${view.capacity}`;
592:     view.card.classList.toggle(
593:       'has-ready',
594:       pots.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY),
595:     );
596:     view.card.classList.toggle(
597:       'is-working',
598:       pots.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING),
599:     );
600:     view.card.classList.toggle('is-full', pots.length >= view.capacity);
601:   }
602: 
603:   const bottler = stationViews.get('bottler');
604:   const pots = core.getPotsAt('bottler');
605:   bottler.slots.replaceChildren(...createSlots(pots, bottler.capacity));
606:   bottler.count.textContent = `${pots.length} / ${bottler.capacity}`;
607:   bottler.card.classList.toggle(
608:     'is-working',
609:     pots.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING),
610:   );
611:   bottler.card.classList.toggle('is-full', pots.length >= bottler.capacity);
612: }
613: 
614: function renderPlan() {
615:   const live = new Set();
616: 
617:   for (const pot of core.activePots) {
618:     if (pot.location === 'intake') {
619:       live.add(0);
620:     } else if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING) {
621:       live.add(pot.stepIndex);
622:     } else if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY) {
623:       live.add(pot.stepIndex);
624:     }
625:   }
626: 
627:   planChips.forEach((chip, index) => {
628:     chip.classList.toggle('is-live', live.has(index));
629:   });
630: }
631: 
632: function stationLabel(id) {
633:   return stationViews.get(id)?.label ?? (id === 'bottler' ? 'BOTTLER' : id);
634: }
635: 
636: function nextDestination(pot) {
637:   if (pot.location === 'bottler') {
638:     return null;
639:   }
640: 
641:   let nextIndex;
642: 
643:   if (pot.location === 'intake') {
644:     nextIndex = 0;
645:   } else if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING) {
646:     nextIndex = pot.stepIndex + 1;
647:   } else {
648:     nextIndex = pot.stepIndex;
649:   }
650: 
651:   const nextProcess = processByIndex[nextIndex] ?? null;
652:   return {
653:     toId: nextProcess ? nextProcess.stationId : 'bottler',
654:     nextIndex,
655:     process: nextProcess,
656:   };
657: }
658: 
659: function renderHint() {
660:   const active = core.activePots;
661:   const ready = active.find((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY);
662: 
663:   if (ready) {
664:     const destination = nextDestination(ready);
665:     const target = stationLabel(destination.toId);
666: 
667:     ui.hint.textContent =
668:       destination.toId === 'bottler'
669:         ? `Pot #${ready.id} is ready at ${stationLabel(
670:             ready.location,
671:           )} — drag it into the BOTTLER before the timer empties.`
672:         : `Pot #${ready.id} is ready at ${stationLabel(
673:             ready.location,
674:           )} — drag it to ${target} (process ${destination.process.order}) before the timer empties.`;
675:     return;
676:   }
677: 
678:   const bottling = active.find(
679:     (pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING,
680:   );
681:   if (bottling) {
682:     const waiting = active.filter(
683:       (pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.QUEUED,
684:     ).length;
685:     ui.hint.textContent = `Pot #${bottling.id} is emptying onto the vial belt — one pot at a time, ${core.config.bottlingMs / 1000} seconds each.${waiting > 0 ? ` ${waiting} pot${waiting === 1 ? '' : 's'} waiting.` : ''}`;
686:     return;
687:   }
688: 
689:   if (active.length === 0) {
690:     ui.hint.textContent =
691:       core.vialsProduced > 0
692:         ? `${core.vialsProduced} vials banked. Take another pot from the intake.`
693:         : 'Take empty pots from the top-left intake.';
694:     return;
695:   }
696: 
697:   if (active.every((pot) => pot.location === 'intake')) {
698:     ui.hint.textContent =
699:       'Drag an empty pot into the GRAIN MILL for process 1.';
700:     return;
701:   }
702: 
703:   ui.hint.textContent =
704:     'Stations work on their own. Keep every pot moving before its ready timer runs out.';
705: }
706: 
707: function render() {
708:   renderHud();
709:   renderPlan();
710:   renderIntake();
711:   renderStations();
712:   renderArrows();
713:   renderHint();
714: }

716: function updateLiveUi() {
717:   document.querySelectorAll('.pot[data-pot-id]').forEach((el) => {
718:     if (el.closest('.fx-layer') || el.classList.contains('drag-ghost')) {
719:       return;
720:     }
721: 
722:     const pot = findPot(Number(el.dataset.potId));
723:     if (!pot) {
724:       return;
