731: 
732: /* ---------- Arrows ---------- */
733: 
734: function svgElement(name) {
735:   return document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', name);
736: }
737: 
738: function nodeRect(id, canvasRect) {
739:   const el = id === 'intake' ? ui.intake : stationViews.get(id)?.card;
740:   if (!el) {
741:     return null;
742:   }
743: 
744:   const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
745:   return {
746:     left: rect.left - canvasRect.left,
747:     top: rect.top - canvasRect.top,
748:     width: rect.width,
749:     height: rect.height,
750:   };
751: }
752: 
753: function centerOf(rect) {
754:   return {
755:     x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
756:     y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
757:   };
758: }
759: 
760: function edgePoint(rect, toward, pad = 7) {
761:   const center = centerOf(rect);
762:   const dx = toward.x - center.x;
763:   const dy = toward.y - center.y;
764:   const halfW = rect.width / 2 + pad;
765:   const halfH = rect.height / 2 + pad;
766: 
767:   if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) {
768:     return center;
769:   }
770: 
771:   const scaleX = dx === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : halfW / Math.abs(dx);
772:   const scaleY = dy === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : halfH / Math.abs(dy);
773:   const scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
774: 
775:   return {
776:     x: center.x + dx * scale,
777:     y: center.y + dy * scale,
778:   };
779: }
780: 
781: function renderArrows() {
782:   const canvasRect = ui.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
783:   const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(canvasRect.width));
784:   const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(canvasRect.height));
785: 
786:   ui.arrows.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
787:   ui.arrows.replaceChildren();
788: 
789:   const defs = svgElement('defs');
790:   defs.innerHTML = `
791:     <marker id="arrow-dim" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5"
792:       markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse">
793:       <path d="M0 0 10 5 0 10z" fill="#6d6855"></path>
794:     </marker>
795:     <marker id="arrow-gold" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5"
796:       markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse">
797:       <path d="M0 0 10 5 0 10z" fill="#f2c94c"></path>
798:     </marker>
799:   `;
800:   ui.arrows.append(defs);
801: 
802:   const groups = new Map();
803: 
804:   for (const pot of core.activePots) {
805:     const destination = nextDestination(pot);
806:     if (!destination || destination.toId === pot.location) {
807:       continue;
808:     }
809: 
810:     const key = `${pot.location}->${destination.toId}`;
811:     let group = groups.get(key);
812: 
813:     if (!group) {
814:       group = {
815:         fromId: pot.location,
816:         toId: destination.toId,
817:         orders: new Set(),
818:         ready: false,
819:         count: 0,
820:       };
821:       groups.set(key, group);
822:     }
823: 
824:     group.count += 1;
825:     group.ready =
826:       group.ready ||
827:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY ||
828:       pot.location === 'intake';
829:     group.orders.add(destination.process?.order ?? 'BTL');
830:   }
831: 
832:   if (groups.size === 0 && core.activePots.length === 0) {
833:     groups.set('intake->mill', {
834:       fromId: 'intake',
835:       toId: 'mill',
836:       orders: new Set([1]),
837:       ready: false,
838:       count: 0,
839:     });
840:   }
841: 
842:   for (const group of groups.values()) {
843:     const fromRect = nodeRect(group.fromId, canvasRect);
844:     const toRect = nodeRect(group.toId, canvasRect);
845: 
846:     if (!fromRect || !toRect) {
847:       continue;
848:     }
849: 
850:     const start = edgePoint(fromRect, centerOf(toRect));
851:     const end = edgePoint(toRect, centerOf(fromRect));
852:     const dx = end.x - start.x;
853:     const dy = end.y - start.y;
854:     const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
855:     const fromIndex = FLOW_INDEX[group.fromId] ?? 0;
856:     const toIndex = FLOW_INDEX[group.toId] ?? 0;
857:     const direction = fromIndex <= toIndex ? 1 : -1;
858:     const bend = Math.min(54, distance * 0.15) * direction;
859:     const normalX = -dy / distance;
860:     const normalY = dx / distance;
861:     const controlX = (start.x + end.x) / 2 + normalX * bend;
862:     const controlY = (start.y + end.y) / 2 + normalY * bend;
863: 
864:     const path = svgElement('path');
865:     path.setAttribute(
866:       'd',
867:       `M ${start.x} ${start.y} Q ${controlX} ${controlY} ${end.x} ${end.y}`,
868:     );
869:     path.setAttribute(
870:       'class',
871:       `arrow ${group.ready ? 'arrow--ready' : 'arrow--waiting'}`,
872:     );
873:     path.setAttribute(
874:       'marker-end',
875:       group.ready ? 'url(#arrow-gold)' : 'url(#arrow-dim)',
876:     );
877:     ui.arrows.append(path);
878: 
879:     const label = svgElement('text');
880:     label.setAttribute('x', String(0.25 * start.x + 0.5 * controlX + 0.25 * end.x));
881:     label.setAttribute('y', String(0.25 * start.y + 0.5 * controlY + 0.25 * end.y));
882:     label.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
883:     label.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'middle');
884:     label.setAttribute(
885:       'class',
886:       `arrow__label${group.ready ? ' arrow__label--ready' : ''}`,
887:     );
888:     label.textContent = [...group.orders].join('·');
889:     ui.arrows.append(label);
890:   }
891: }
892: 
893: /* ---------- Drag and drop ---------- */
894: 
895: function updateDragCards() {
896:   const expected = drag ? nextDestination(findPot(drag.potId))?.toId : null;
897: 
898:   for (const [id, view] of stationViews) {
899:     view.card.classList.toggle('is-valid-target', id === expected);
900:     view.card.classList.remove('is-drop-invalid');
901:   }
902: }
903: 
904: function targetUnderPointer(clientX, clientY) {
905:   const el = document.elementFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
906:   const card = el?.closest('.station');
907:   const id = card?.dataset.stationId;
908: 
909:   return id && stationViews.has(id) ? id : null;
910: }
911: 
912: function moveGhost(clientX, clientY) {
913:   if (!drag) {
914:     return;
915:   }
916:   drag.ghost.style.left = `${clientX - drag.offsetX}px`;
917:   drag.ghost.style.top = `${clientY - drag.offsetY}px`;
918: }
919: 
920: function onPointerMove(event) {
921:   if (!drag) {
922:     return;
923:   }
924: 
925:   sendPointer(event);
926:   moveGhost(event.clientX, event.clientY);
927:   const targetId = targetUnderPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY);
928: 
929:   if (targetId === drag.hoverId) {
930:     return;
931:   }
932: 
933:   drag.hoverId = targetId;
934: 
935:   for (const [id, view] of stationViews) {
936:     view.card.classList.toggle('is-drop-hover', id === targetId);
937:     view.card.classList.toggle(
938:       'is-drop-invalid',
939:       id === targetId && id !== drag.expectedId,
940:     );
941:   }
942: }
943: 
944: function cleanupDrag() {
945:   if (!drag) {
946:     return;
947:   }
948: 
949:   drag.ghost.remove();
950:   drag.originEl?.classList.remove('is-dragging-source');
951:   document.body.classList.remove('is-dragging');
952: 
953:   for (const view of stationViews.values()) {
954:     view.card.classList.remove(
955:       'is-valid-target',
956:       'is-drop-hover',
957:       'is-drop-invalid',
958:     );
959:   }
960: 
961:   window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
962:   window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
963:   window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
964:   drag = null;
965: }
966: 
967: function onPointerUp(event) {
968:   if (!drag) {
969:     return;
970:   }
971: 
972:   const potId = drag.potId;
973:   const targetId = targetUnderPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY);
974: 
975:   cleanupDrag();
976: 
977:   if (embedded) {
978:     sendPointer(event, false);
979: 
980:     if (targetId) {
981:       sendFactoryAction('drop', { potId, targetId });
982:     }
983:     sendFactoryAction('release', { potId });
984:     render();
985:     return;
986:   }
987: 
988:   if (targetId) {
989:     const eventResult = core.dropPot(potId, targetId);
990: 
991:     if (eventResult.type === 'rejected') {
992:       toast(rejectionText(eventResult));
993:     }
994:   }
995: 
996:   render();
997: }
998: 
999: function onPointerCancel() {
1000:   const potId = drag?.potId ?? null;
1001:   cleanupDrag();
1002: 
1003:   if (embedded && potId !== null) {
1004:     sendFactoryAction('release', { potId });
1005:   }
1006: 
1007:   render();
1008: }
1009: 
1010: function onPointerDown(event) {
1011:   if (event.button !== 0) {
1012:     return;
1013:   }
1014: 
1015:   const potEl = event.target.closest('.pot');
1016:   if (!potEl || potEl.closest('.fx-layer')) {
1017:     return;
1018:   }
1019: 
1020:   const pot = findPot(Number(potEl.dataset.potId));
1021:   if (!pot) {
1022:     return;
1023:   }
1024: 
1025:   if (!isDraggable(pot)) {
1026:     if (
1027:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING ||
1028:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING
1029:     ) {
1030:       toast(`Pot #${pot.id} is still working.`);
1031:     }
1032:     return;
1033:   }
1034: 
1035:   if (embedded) {
1036:     const owner = remoteOwners.get(pot.id);
1037:     if (owner && owner.clientId !== remoteClientId) {
1038:       toast(`Pot #${pot.id} is claimed by ${owner.name ?? 'another comrade'}.`);
1039:       return;
1040:     }
1041:     sendFactoryAction('claim', { potId: pot.id });
1042:     sendPointer(event);
1043:   }
1044: 
1045:   event.preventDefault();
1046: 
1047:   const rect = potEl.getBoundingClientRect();
1048:   const ghost = potEl.cloneNode(true);
1049:   ghost.classList.remove('is-working', 'is-ready', 'is-urgent', 'is-warning');
1050:   ghost.classList.add('drag-ghost');
1051:   ghost.style.left = `${rect.left}px`;
1052:   ghost.style.top = `${rect.top}px`;
1053:   ghost.style.width = `${rect.width}px`;
1054:   ghost.style.height = `${rect.height}px`;
1055:   ghost.tabIndex = -1;
1056:   ui.fx.append(ghost);
1057: 
1058:   potEl.classList.add('is-dragging-source');
1059: 
1060:   drag = {
1061:     potId: pot.id,
1062:     ghost,
1063:     originEl: potEl,
1064:     offsetX: event.clientX - rect.left,
1065:     offsetY: event.clientY - rect.top,
1066:     expectedId: nextDestination(pot)?.toId ?? null,
1067:     hoverId: null,
1068:   };
1069: 
1070:   document.body.classList.add('is-dragging');
1071:   updateDragCards();
1072: 
1073:   window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
1074:   window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
1075:   window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
1076: }
1077: 
1078: /* ---------- Events, FX, and hints ---------- */
1079: 
1080: function stationName(id) {
1081:   return id === 'bottler' ? 'BOTTLER' : stationMeta.get(id)?.name ?? id;
1082: }
1083: 
1084: function rejectionText(event) {
1085:   switch (event.reason) {
1086:     case 'wrong-station':
1087:       return `Wrong station — that pot needs ${stationName(
1088:         event.expectedStationId,
1089:       )} for process ${event.process?.order}.`;
1090:     case 'pot-busy':
1091:       return 'That pot is still being processed.';
1092:     case 'station-full':

1269: const vialEmitted = new Map();
1270: 
1271: function vialQuota(progressMs) {
1272:   const perVial = core.config.bottlingMs / core.config.vialsPerPot;
1273:   return Math.max(
1274:     0,
1275:     Math.min(
1276:       core.config.vialsPerPot,
1277:       Math.floor(progressMs / perVial + 1e-6),
1278:     ),
1279:   );
1280: }
1281: 
1282: function updateBottlingFlow() {
1283:   const active = core.pots.find(
1284:     (pot) =>
1285:       pot.location === 'bottler' && pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING,
1286:   );
1287: 
1288:   if (!active) {
1289:     return;
1290:   }
1291: 
1292:   const emitted = vialQuota(active.progressMs);
1293:   const previous = vialEmitted.get(active.id) ?? 0;
1294: 
1295:   if (emitted <= previous) {
1296:     return;
1297:   }
1298: 
1299:   for (let index = previous; index < emitted; index += 1) {
1300:     spawnVial();
1301:   }
1302:   vialEmitted.set(active.id, emitted);
1303: }
1304: 
1305: function handleEvents(events) {
1306:   for (const event of events) {
1307:     switch (event.type) {
1308:       case 'process-complete':
1309:         pulseStation(event.stationId);
1310:         break;
1311:       case 'pot-spoiled':
1312:         captureSpoiledFx(event.potId);
1313:         toast(
1314:           `Pot #${event.potId} spoiled at ${stationLabel(event.stationId)} — the timer ran out.`,
1315:         );
1316:         break;
1317:       case 'pot-bottled': {
1318:         const already = vialEmitted.get(event.potId) ?? 0;
1319:         const remaining = Math.max(0, event.vials - already);
1320:         for (let index = 0; index < remaining; index += 1) {
1321:           spawnVial();
1322:         }
1323:         vialEmitted.delete(event.potId);
1324:         sendPotDownEmpties(event.potId);
1325:         break;
1326:       }
1327:       default:
1328:         break;
1329:     }
1330:   }
1331: }

1366: function frame(now) {
1367:   const delta = Math.min(250, Math.max(0, now - lastFrame));
1368:   lastFrame = now;
1369: 
1370:   if (!document.hidden && !embedded) {
1371:     const result = core.advance(delta);
1372: 
1373:     if (result.events.length > 0) {
1374:       handleEvents(result.events);

1384:   }
1385: 
1386:   window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
1387: }

138:   /* ------------------------------ internals ------------------------------ */
139: 
140:   #ensureFrame() {
141:     if (this.loadedTask === this.task) {
142:       return;
143:     }
144: 
145:     const meta = MINIGAMES[this.task];
146:     this.loadedTask = this.task;
147:     this.frameLoaded = false;
148:     this.frame.src = `${meta.src}?embed=1`;
149:   }
150: 
151:   #renderChrome() {
152:     const meta = MINIGAMES[this.task];
153:     this.root.dataset.task = this.task;
154:     this.title.textContent = meta.title;
155:     this.hint.textContent = meta.hint;
156: 
157:     for (const tab of this.tabs) {
158:       tab.classList.toggle('is-active', tab.dataset.ghostTask === this.task);
159:       tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(tab.dataset.ghostTask === this.task));
160:     }
161: 
162:     if (this.state?.eliminated) {

164:     } else if (this.task === 'dash' && this.state?.factory) {
165:       const factory = this.state.factory;

167:     } else if (this.task === 'clicker') {

169:     } else {

171:     }
172:   }
173: 
174:   #sendState() {
175:     if (!this.frameLoaded || !this.frame?.contentWindow) {
176:       return;
177:     }
178: 
179:     this.frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
180:       {
181:         type: 'state',

183:         clientId: this.identity.clientId,
184:         teamId: this.identity.teamId,
185:         playerId: this.identity.playerId,

194:       window.location.origin,

196:   }
197: 
198:   #handleMessage(data) {
199:     if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
200:       return;
201:     }
202: 
203:     if (data.type === 'minigame-ready') {
204:       this.#sendState();
205:       this.frame.contentWindow?.focus();
206:       return;
207:     }
208: 
209:     if (data.type === 'contribute') {
210:       this.onContribute({
211:         game: data.game,
212:         resources: data.resources ?? {},
213:       });
214:       return;
215:     }
216: 
217:     if (data.type === 'factory-action') {
218:       this.onFactoryAction({
219:         action: data.action,
220:         potId: data.potId,
221:         targetId: data.targetId,
222:       });
223:       return;
224:     }
225: 
226:     if (data.type === 'pointer') {
227:       const now = performance.now();
228:       if (data.active !== false && now < this.pointerNext) {
229:         return;
230:       }
231:       this.pointerNext = now + 60;
232:       this.onPointer({ x: data.x, y: data.y, active: data.active });
233:     }
234:   }
235: }

237: export { MINIGAMES, TASKS };
